capabilities: Visualize note relationships from shared context and direct links
Focus the graph on a project defined in frontmatter
Style nodes and navigate the graph interactively
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it was awaiting approval in the community plugin directory at the time of the README.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph only shows direct links, so relationships between notes that share context but aren't linked are invisible.
summary: Graph view that visualizes note relationships from shared context, direct links, and recency, with filters and project focus.
